question: Will Bitcoin (BTC) reach $85,000 before September 1, 2026 (00:00 UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if BTC/USDT on Binance reaches a traded price of $85,000 or above at any point before September 1, 2026, 00:00 UTC.
- "No": Wins if BTC/USDT on Binance does not reach a traded price of $85,000 or above at any point before September 1, 2026, 00:00 UTC.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $85,000" means any single executed trade on Binance is recorded at or above $85,000 USD at any moment in the observation window (from market creation to Sep 1, 2026, 00:00 UTC).
